event.text: Prince Arthur, a son of Queen Victoria, became the first Governor General of Canada of royal descent, as well as the first Prince of Great Britain and Ireland to hold that position.
event.page_title: Prince Arthur, Duke of Connaught and Strathearn
event.page_extract: Prince Arthur, Duke of Connaught and Strathearn, was the seventh child and third son of Queen Victoria of the United Kingdom and Prince Albert of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha. He served as Governor General of Canada, the tenth since Canadian Confederation and the only British prince to do so.

title: The Vice-Regal Winter
artist_statement: He carried the weight of a distant crown into a landscape that did not yet know him. The cold here is different—it does not defer to rank. I wanted to paint the moment when ceremony meets that indifference, and a man becomes a silhouette.
image_prompt: A tall figure in a scarlet military greatcoat with fur collar stands alone in a high-ceilinged stone room, his back to the viewer, one hand resting on the sill of a tall frost-edged window. Outside, a wide river is locked in pale ice, and sparse snow falls through the amber light of late afternoon. On a walnut table beside him lie white gloves, a brass telescope, and a folded dispatch, their shadows long. The brushwork is visible and dry, with muted greys, deep blues, and one warm shaft of light falling across the floorboards.
